caveat: Figures are third-party aggregator data (CollegeDunia/Shiksha), cross-checked where possible, for AY 2026-27. These change annually and are subject to Gujarat FRC (Fee Regulatory Committee) approval — always confirm against the official fee circular on nirmauni.ac.in/online-fees-payment before quoting to students.

btech_2026_27.hostel: No on-campus hostel facility for B.Tech students as of this data; university provides guidance for off-campus PG/hostel accommodation (third-party PG hostels near campus commonly cited around INR 80,000-100,000/year) and a bus facility from Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar.

mtech_mca_approx.tuition_per_semester_inr_approx: 120000+ (varies by programme, third-party estimate, unverified against official circular)
mtech_mca_approx.gate_scholarship: Available for GATE-qualified MTech students; merit-based support for non-GATE students

older_reference_point.note: One alumni review cited historical BTech annual fee rising from ~INR 1,20,000 to ~INR 1,40,000 in an earlier cohort — included only to show the fee trend over years, not current.
